name: Modal
purpose: Dialog that interrupts the current task for a focused decision or short form (confirm delete, edit score). Becomes a bottom sheet on small screens.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the modal is shown. The parent owns this state.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on Escape, close button, backdrop click (or Android back).

props.name: role
props.description: alertdialog for urgent confirmations; disables backdrop-click close by default.

props.name: closeOnBackdropClick
props.default: true for dialog, false for alertdialog

props.name: hideCloseButton
props.description: Hide the X button (ensure another way to close).

props.name: initialFocusRef
props.description: Element to focus on open (default: first focusable).

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the X button.

states.name: closed
states.description: Not rendered to the accessibility tree.

states.name: open
states.description: Backdrop scrim, page inert, focus inside, scroll locked.

tokens.usage: Corners (radius.xl top corners for bottom sheet).

accessibility.role: dialog / alertdialog (native <dialog> opened with showModal()) / RN Modal with accessibilityViewIsModal

keyboard.action: Cycle through focusable elements inside the dialog only.

screenReader: Content outside is inert and hidden from assistive tech.
accessibility.focus: Focus moves into the dialog on open and returns to the triggering element on close.
notes: Don't open modals automatically on page load (IBM 3.2.1 On Focus / unexpected context change).

variants.name: dialog
variants.description: Standard modal with form or content.

do: Use a clear title that states the question or task ('Delete Team Rockets?').
Label buttons with the outcome ('Delete team' / 'Keep team'), not 'Yes/No'.
Keep content short; use a page for long flows.
dont: Don't stack modals on top of modals.
Don't use for non-critical info — use inline messages.
Don't hide the close affordance without another clear way out.

example.web:
<Modal
  open={open}
  onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
  role="alertdialog"
  title="Delete Team Rockets?"
  description="Their match history will be removed. This can't be undone."
  footer={<>
    <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Keep team</Button>
    <Button variant="danger" onClick={deleteTeam}>Delete team</Button>
  </>}
/>
example.native: <Modal open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title="Delete Team Rockets?" footer={<Button variant="danger" onPress={deleteTeam}>Delete team</Button>} />
